info.title: Gasket version 1 maintenance API
info.description: Versioned native maintenance records, procedures, assignments, execution, independent decisions and authorized read models. API.md documents native field semantics, bounds and operational recovery. POST requests require the installation Origin header. The nine approved service scopes remain restricted to estate operations; other operations require ordinary member sessions. Provider capabilities and future product features are not implied by these native doors.
